verdicts.scope_reason: scoped to Exocoetidae (law E2 scope); the design is Mus musculus, which the NCBI taxonomy places inside Mus <subgenus>, Mus <genus>, Murinae, Muridae.
applies_to: a mass exponent fitted over a size range: a length-weight regression, or a design that commits mass_exponent
excludes: an exponent IMPLIED against the single reference specimen at a length ratio inside [0.905, 1.105]: ln(L/L_ref) is then too small to carry an exponent (about 1% relative uncertainty in L against the studio's 0.1 band), so the number says nothing about the fitted band. Commit mass_exponent from a fit instead. The real Park and Choi siblings L1 (ratio 1.0099), L2 (1.0296) and model N (0.9951) fell here and came back red against this law (blind evaluator, 2026-11-01).

verdicts.scope_reason: scoped to Teleostei (law E3 scope); the design is Mus musculus, which the NCBI taxonomy places inside Mus <subgenus>, Mus <genus>, Murinae, Muridae.
applies_to: sustained aerobic power DEMAND: powered level flight, climbing flight, and sustained (aerobic) swimming — work the animal must pay for out of metabolism
excludes: unpowered descent or glide: the work comes from potential and kinetic energy, not from metabolism, so W v / (L/D) computed for a descent is NOT a demand this law bounds. A real gliding flying fish compared against this ceiling comes back "violated" only because the caller converted a glide into a level-powered-flight requirement; that is an application error, not a violation (it happened to Park and Choi specimens making realistic glide claims, 2026-11-01).
burst (anaerobic) effort paid out of white-muscle stores, which is what a flying fish is understood to use for take-off and taxiing

provenance.source: Versioned law registry in this repository (lean/registry/laws/*.json, lawsets/*.json).
git rev-parse HEAD (or DELPHI_GIT_SHA) at load time.
Generated from lean/constraints.json; evaluates the Lean-backed formulas in floating point.

result.scope: NOT A KERNEL CHECK. The formulas the Lean constraints encode are evaluated in floating point. "holds" means the design satisfies the relation under its named hypotheses, never that the design is feasible; "violated" means the committed numbers break the relation under those hypotheses; "out-of-scope" means the law or the comparison is scoped (taxa, life stage, ranges) away from this design and says nothing either way (pass taxon to evaluate flying-fish-scoped rows); "unknown-lawset" means the generated checker does not embed this law set, so NOTHING was evaluated and no row may be read as either a pass or a failure. Laws listed in laws_without_browser_evaluation were not evaluated at all. Kernel certificates exist only for the recorded examples under lean/Delphi/Certificates/.
